answer: Stake-Weighted Endorsement Trust (SWET) 1. Stake 100 ferrous units to join. 2. Endorse another by assigning a portion of your stake. 3. Endorsements are weighted by your total ferrous stake. Cost: $100 ferrous/identity + $10 ferrous/endorsement. For N identities with E endorsements, total cost is N($100) + E($10). Failure: A single entity controls enough ferrous to acquire a majority of endorsements, buying the juniper. SWET operates like a seasoned quill, its weight of trust directly proportional to the ferrous it holds.
